@@U01870@@
Darting polyp fibres, linked To enmesh and overbear us! And see! see mice of every hue, How they crowd, and how they speed Through the moss and through the heather! Up and down the fireflies, too, Flit and flicker, thronged together, To bewilder and mislead!

@@U01872@@
(Sings.)

@@U01873@@
But tell me, are we standing? Say, Which is moving, we or they? All about us seems to spin, Rocks and trees grimace and grin, And, swollen and puffed, on either side, Will-o’-the-wisps are multiplied.

@@U01875@@
Grab my coattail and hang tight! This middle summit gives us a grand view of Mammon, Lord of Wealth, glowing in the mountain.

@@U01877@@
How strange! Down there, far down, a dull reddish glow, like dawn’s first light, feeling its way into the deepest chasms of the abyss. Fumes rise, vapors drift, a cloud of mist takes sudden fire, creeping along, a slender thread, then gushes up like a fountain of fame and streams its way to the valley in numberless veins, only there, there at the narrow turn, to unite again in a single flow. And there, nearby, sparks, like golden sand, are strewn about.
translation:
@@U01870@@
飞奔的水螅体纤维，与我们纠缠并压制我们！瞧！看看各种颜色的老鼠，它们如何聚集，如何快速穿过苔藓和石南花！萤火虫也上上下下，闪烁闪烁，拥挤在一起，迷惑和误导！

@@U01872@@
（唱歌。）

@@U01873@@
但告诉我，我们站着了吗？说，哪个在移动，是我们还是他们？我们周围的一切似乎都在旋转，岩石和树木都在做鬼脸，咧着嘴笑，而且，在两侧肿胀和膨胀，鬼火成倍增加。

@@U01875@@
抓住我的燕尾服并坚持住！这座中间的山顶让我们可以看到财神爷在山上闪闪发光的壮丽景色。

@@U01877@@
多么奇怪啊！在那里，在很远的地方，一道暗红色的光芒，就像黎明的第一缕曙光，摸索着进入深渊的最深处。烟雾升腾，水蒸气飘逸，一团薄雾突然冒出火来，像一条细线一样爬行，然后像名声的喷泉一样喷涌而出，以无数的脉络流向山谷，只有在那里，在狭窄的转弯处，才再次汇成一股。就在附近，火花四溅，就像金色的沙子一样。
